Hi Rishi / Laura —

Following up on Riley Chan (SWE candidate, applied for infra team). I drafted a short, time-boxed async assignment to surface design thought + small implementation. Can you review and confirm we can send today? Key items: 

- Target completion time for candidate: 48 hours
- Deliverable: short design writeup + one small repo with a README and two unit tests
- Reviewer panel: primary reviewer + secondary for tie-break / score normalization

I've attached the prompt (riley_assignment_prompt.md). Suggested reviewers: Rishi primary, Stephanie backup. Proposed debrief slot: Mon Aug 24 10:00-10:30 PT (quick sync + rubric calibration).

Please mark any content edits inline or reply with approval. If approved, I will send to Riley with deadline and instructions.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa — thanks for the draft. Quick notes: 

- Change the dataset wording to 'synthetic request logs' to avoid implying access to PII.
- Make the scoring rubric clearer on trade-offs (latency vs cost). Add a 1-paragraph "what to evaluate" section.
- 48 hours is fine; let's add a fallback of 72 hours if candidate requests it.

I approve sending once the two edits above are applied. I'll take primary review; Stephanie will be backup. Laura, can you add the debrief invite to my calendar (Mon Aug 24 10:00 PT) and attach the rubric?

Hi Riley —

Thanks for taking the interview step with Redwood. Attached is a short assignment we ask candidates to complete as part of the on-site loop. Please review and submit within 48 hours; if you need extra time, reply and we'll extend to 72 hours.

What we expect:
- A short design note (1 page) explaining the approach and trade-offs
- A minimal code repo with a README and 2 unit tests demonstrating the core idea
- A ZIP or link to a GitHub repo in your reply

Attachments: riley_assignment_prompt.md (includes inputs and scoring rubric).

Deadline: submit by 2026-08-19T11:00:00-07:00 (48 hours) unless you request an extension.

If you have policy/PII questions or need clarification on allowed libraries, ask us — happy to clarify.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
